Hark listens for a custom wake word and alerts you with a loud chime the moment it hears it, even with the app running in the background.
Microphone access is required for wake word detection. Notification permission lets us alert you when the app is backgrounded.

Lower values cut false alarms and need clearer speech, but respond a little slower. Higher values react faster and trigger more easily. Similar sounding words such as \'hard\' or \'park\' can still trigger a short wake word like \'hark\'. A longer, more distinctive word works best.
